origin: Written for this repository. Every name, site, asset, reading, standard number and signature is invented; no real inspection, person, organisation or site is represented.
licence: Same licence as this repository. No third-party text, image, model or dataset is included, so no external licence applies.
confidentiality: Synthetic throughout. Nothing here is a real confidential scan, and no real document was copied, paraphrased or used as a template.
why_synthetic: AGENTS.md forbids committing private documents or real confidential scans. A synthetic pack with known-correct answers is also the only way to check extraction against ground truth rather than against a plausible-looking reading.
raster_scan_status: INCLUDED. documents/inspection-report-scan.pdf is a three-page raster-only PDF: each page holds one FlateDecode DeviceGray image and the content stream contains a single image-draw operator. There is no text layer and no font resource, so nothing can be extracted from it without rendering and OCR. inspection-report.txt remains the ground truth for what a correct reading produces.

scan.generation_method: A 5x7 bitmap font defined in the generator renders inspection-report.txt to pixel buffers; a fixed-seed linear congruential generator adds deterministic speckle; the pages are zlib-compressed into a hand-written PDF with no /Producer, /CreationDate or /ID. Standard library only: zlib and arithmetic.
scan.tool_versions: CPython 3.14.6 and 3.12.13 on macOS produce identical bytes; the output depends only on zlib's deflate, and the recorded hash is checked on every run of fixtures/c07/test_fixtures.py.
scan.no_dependency_added: Pillow or reportlab would be a new pinned wheel, new provenance and a new image build for a fixture. Neither is installed and neither is needed.
